brief.headline: They lost money last year and carry high debt — lead with faster payment (worth ~11% to them) for a price cut, but keep a second source ready.

priceAsk.summary: Ask them to match Shrinath Roto Pack's ₹290.00/KG on the top three SKUs we buy.
priceAsk.basis: We already pay ₹290.00/KG to Shrinath Roto Pack for the same laminates; they charge us ₹295.00/KG — a 1.7% gap. The open market asks ₹205–305/kg (typical ₹250/kg) for pharma ORS sachet laminate, so our ₹295.00/KG sits at the top of fair; ₹290.00/KG is still fair and matches our best price.

paymentTermAsk.summary: Offer to pay them in 15 days (half our current 30) in exchange for the ₹5/KG price cut.
paymentTermAsk.cashImpact: Paying 15 days earlier costs us ₹9.49 L in cash freed up, but they borrow money at about 10.96%, so 15 days early is worth roughly 0.45% to them — on our ₹2.31 Cr spend that's about ₹10 L of value to them, which covers the ₹3.91 L price cut and then some.

brief.financialLeverage: They made a loss of ₹-23.68 Cr in FY2024-25 and keep -3.4% of every ₹100 they sell (similar firms keep 2.5%), so they have no profit cushion. They owe 2.15x their own cash (₹208.21 Cr total debt) and can barely cover interest (0.06x). Their overall money-health score is 2/10 and they sit in the grey zone (Altman Z 1.68) — meaning financial stress. We are only 0.33% of their ₹691.05 Cr revenue, so we're tiny to them and can't squeeze hard without risking supply. But they take 53d to pay their own suppliers (vs 36d for peers), so they stretch cash — which means faster payment from us is very valuable. Push gently: offer the faster payment as a carrot, ask for the price match, and make it clear we're lining up a second source to protect our supply.

alternates.name: Huhtamaki India Ltd (already a small FDC supplier)
alternates.why: Listed flexible-packaging converter proven for laminate sachets — a scalable second source we already know.

alternates.name: UFLEX Ltd
alternates.why: Listed flexibles giant that makes both film and converts it — can handle our laminate volume at scale.

alternates.name: Constantia Parikh Packaging Pvt Ltd
alternates.why: Global Constantia's India converter for pharma blister and sachet laminates (₹222.04 Cr revenue, D 31/100 health) — strong second-source to qualify.

risks: They're loss-making with high debt and a grey-zone distress signal — pushing too hard on price could tip them over and leave us without supply.
Their credit rating is IVR BBB- / Stable and they have severe legal cases, GST filing delays and EPF payment delays flagged — watch for delivery hiccups.
We're only 0.33% of their revenue, so we have almost no volume leverage — the faster-payment offer is our main card.
Shrinath Roto Pack gives us ₹290.00/KG, so if GLS won't match it we can shift more volume there or bring in Huhtamaki or UFLEX as a second line.
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We value the partnership, but we're paying ₹295 when our best laminate price is ₹290 — and with your cash being tight, we'd like to help by paying you in 15 days instead of 30 if you can match that ₹290 price.
